author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Bank branches will be closed in Odisha, Uttarakhand, and Manipur on July 16. These closures are for Ratha Yatra and the Harela festival celebrations. Customers can still use online and mobile banking services for transactions. Other regional holidays are scheduled later this month across various states. Regular banking operations will resume on the next working day.
title: Are banks closed today for Rath Yatra and Harela? Check state-wise list

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon detailed extensive leadership requirements for his successor.  He emphasized a blend of analytical skills, work ethic, and human qualities.  The next leader must navigate global politics and understand complex back-office functions.  Dimon expressed confidence in the bank's deep talent pool for the transition.  He currently has no immediate plans for retirement from his leadership role.
title: Dimon shares list of leadership traits that he wants to see in JPMorgan's next CEO

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: President Trump warned Iran to behave if it desires negotiations with Washington. US forces conducted new military strikes targeting Iranian command centers and air defense systems. These strikes aimed to degrade Iran's ability to threaten commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian authorities reported a missile attack near a cancer hospital in Ahvaz. Damage was also reported at an industrial facility in Qeshm following an enemy attack.
title: 'They better behave': Trump says Iran wants settlement amid fresh strikes

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Shubman Gill's unbeaten 80 against England in the first ODI at Edgbaston was a lesson in calculated ODI batting rather than outright aggression. On a seamer-friendly surface, he absorbed pressure, rebuilt after India's early setbacks and accelerated at the right moments to steer the chase. Even cramps couldn't derail his composure, reinforcing why Gill, who is still uncertain for the second ODI in Cardiff, is rapidly becoming India's premier chase specialist, much like Virat Kohli.
title: Gill's chase at Edgbaston showed why India already have Kohli's ODI heir

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Stabbed because of religion: What we know about attack on Indian-origin man in US

author: H M CHAITHANYA SWAMY
description: A law student died after being stabbed by the brother of a man whose marriage proposal she rejected. The accused attacked the victim at her residence after she ended their relationship. He allegedly used a knife during the altercation, inflicting serious chest and back wounds. Local residents apprehended the attacker immediately after the violent incident occurred. Police have arrested both brothers and are continuing their thorough investigation.
title: Bengaluru law student dies after man stabs her for rejecting his brother's marriage proposal

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Will Grier has announced his retirement from professional football after seven seasons.  He played for six different franchises during his NFL career.  Grier shared his decision publicly through an Instagram post.  Teammates like Dak Prescott and Christian McCaffrey offered their congratulations.  His departure leaves a respected legacy among former colleagues.
title: Dak Prescott, Drake Maye react as former Cowboys QB announces retirement

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: England's Jude Bellingham clashed with Argentina players after their World Cup semifinal defeat.  A video showed Bellingham tapping defender Valentin Barco on the head.  The match saw England lose 2-1, ending their World Cup final hopes.  Argentina will now face Spain in the final for a second title.  England plays France in the third-place playoff match.
title: Bellingham slaps Argentina player on the head after England's semifinal defeat

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'There were mistakes': Acting US attorney general Blanche grilled over Trump ties and Epstein files

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Jon Gruden discussed his biggest coaching regret, the Antonio Brown situation with the Raiders. He expressed concern over modern NFL offenses, which he feels lack communication. ​During a recent appearance on Cam Heyward's Not Just Football podcast, the Super Bowl winning coach reflected on one of the biggest disappointments of his career and shared why he believes today's NFL is moving in the wrong direction.
title: Jon Gruden on Antonio Brown: 'He finished everything' and NFL's future

author: TOI NEWS DESK
description: Sonam Wangchuk continues his hunger strike for nineteen days, stating his health is not critical. He urged supporters to join a Parliament march on July 20 instead of asking him to break his fast. Wangchuk believes his protest sends a message about government accountability and the need for action. His health has been monitored, and medical tests show stable results for his condition.
title: 'Not in good shape but ...': Sonam Wangchuk refuses to end fast despite health concerns

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A group of OpenAI employees has donated over $215,000 to Guardrails Alliance, a super PAC pushing for stricter AI regulation—directly opposing their own president, Greg Brockman, who helped fund rival PAC Leading the Future. The revolt exposes a deepening rift inside the ChatGPT-maker over who should write the rules governing frontier AI.
title: OpenAI staff donate $215,000 to group pushing AI rules Sam Altman opposes

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A new US dollar coin will feature President Donald Trump for America's 250th birthday. This commemorative coin is scheduled for release in the autumn of 2026. The design includes Trump's image and traditional American symbols on both sides. Critics raised concerns about this move conflicting with an 1866 law. The Treasury Department stated the coin is legal under a 2020 act.
title: 'Very cute': US President Donald Trump welcomes new $1 coin with his face on it

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US defense secretary Pete Hegseth announced a new annual testosterone screening program. This initiative will target military personnel aged thirty and older for better performance. Service members under thirty can volunteer for testing, while therapy remains voluntary. Medical experts note testosterone decline with age, impacting various health aspects, while critics question the policy.
title: 'To keep troops at their absolute best': US to begin annual testosterone screening for service members, says Pete Hegseth

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Apple's artificial intelligence service has received approval for release in China. Chinese regulators granted Apple a license to roll out its AI service. Alibaba and Baidu will serve as technical partners for Apple's AI. This clearance allows Apple to tap into China's keen AI technology market. The service could become available to iPhone users later this year or early 2027.
title: After two years, China says 'yes' to allow Apple Intelligence on iPhones in the country

author: TOI NEWS DESK
title: FDA raids Siya Goyal's father's shop, seizes food products worth over Rs 8 lakh

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Lionel Messi and Argentina teammates sparked a viral moment after their World Cup semi-final victory over England, as they inspected Jordan Pickford's penalty notes taped to his water bottle. The England goalkeeper's preparations for a shootout went unused after Lautaro Martínez's stoppage-time winner sealed a 2-1 comeback. Messi's amused reaction quickly became one of the tournament's most talked-about moments.
title: Messi's reaction after Argentina players find England goalkeeper's secret penalty notes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'Certain elements' in Israeli government want endless war, says JD Vance

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Antonela Roccuzzo backed Lionel Messi and Argentina with heartfelt Instagram messages after their World Cup victories, while the Messi family also shared an update confirming Jorge Messi is recovering from health issues. Messi admitted he endured "difficult days" during the tournament, making Argentina's run to the World Cup semifinal even more emotional for the family.
title: Antonela Roccuzzo shares emotional family update as Messi stays focused on World Cup

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: The Israel Defense Forces removed soldier Shira Braun from its international communications unit and imposed a suspended jail sentence after she appeared in a livestream with controversial influencer Braden "Clavicular" Peters. The IDF said the action was based on her conduct, not misuse of official systems. Peters, known for his ties to polarizing internet figures and controversial content, drew criticism during his Israel visit, prompting debate over military standards, influencer culture, and institutional accountability.
title: Clavicular's Israel visit sparks controversy after IDF sidelines soldier over livestream

author: AABHAS SHARMA AND SIDHARTHA
description: British car prices are decreasing as the India-UK CETA agreement begins implementation. Imported Scotch and Indian whiskies will see price reductions after state excise clearances. Car manufacturers like JLR and McLaren have already announced significant price cuts on their vehicles. Alcohol taxes remain high, impacting the extent of price reductions for consumers. Companies will decide if duty benefits are passed on to customers.
title: India-UK trade deal: British cars get cheaper but Scotch has to wait

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Harry Kane has revealed Thomas Tuchel's final touchline instruction before England's World Cup semi-final collapse against Argentina. Despite taking the lead, Tuchel urged his players to keep attacking rather than defend. England instead conceded twice late on, with Kane admitting the team ultimately tried to hold on as another major tournament ended in heartbreaking fashion.
title: 'We're gutted': Harry Kane reveals Tuchel's final instruction England failed to follow

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
title: Government hikes export duty on diesel to Rs 15.5/litre, ATF to Rs 14.5/litre: Report

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Crude oil prices climbed for a fourth day, exceeding eighty-five dollars per barrel. Investors reacted to escalating United States and Iran conflict and shipping route security. United States strikes on Iran's missile sites and coastal defense positions occurred. This intensified worries over oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz. Analysts suggest prices could rise further depending on conflict developments.
title: Oil prices extend gain for fourth day, stay beyond $85 amid Middle East chaos

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Argentina may face FIFA disciplinary action after displaying a Falklands sovereignty banner.  The team celebrated a World Cup semi-final victory over England with the controversial message.  This political display follows a similar incident for which Argentina was previously fined.  Argentina's vice-president supported the players' actions on social media platforms.  The team now prepares for the World Cup final against Spain.
title: Argentina risk FIFA punishment after Falkland Islands banner during England win celebrations

author: TNN
description: Police exhumed a woman's body from her husband's home after she was allegedly murdered. Her husband buried her body inside the house and plastered the floor. He then filed a missing person report to divert suspicion from himself. The woman's mother had alleged her son-in-law and his parents killed her daughter. An FIR was registered, and teams are working to arrest the accused.
title: UP horror: Man kills wife, buries her under mud floor, sleeps over spot for days

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: Patrick Mahomes sparked online debate after publicly interacting with Brittany Mahomes' Instagram post but not sharing a birthday tribute for his half-sister, Mia Randall. Fans quickly noticed the omission, though there is no indication he didn't celebrate privately. The Chiefs quarterback is also balancing a busy offseason of celebrity events while preparing for the 2026 NFL season.
title: Patrick Mahomes' silence on Mia's birthday fuels family feud rumors as fans speculate

author: ANUJA JAISWAL
description: India's MBBS capacity reaches a record 1,36,939 seats for the 2026-27 academic session. This expansion is driven by new regulations allowing earlier seat increase applications. The National Medical Commission approved 9,911 additional undergraduate seats across the nation. These new seats include those in newly established and existing medical colleges. Private institutions contributed significantly to this substantial increase in medical seats.
title: Nearly 10,000 more MBBS seats up for grabs this year

author: SUBODH GHILDIYAL
description: The Congress party is not favoring a leadership change in its Punjab unit. This stance comes despite some functionaries demanding Amarinder Raja Warring's removal. Party leaders are wary of reversing recent appointments, which caused internal backlash. Dissidence presents a difficult situation for the Congress party ahead of polls. The party may try to persuade dissidents with assurances and future promises.
title: 2022 in mind, Congress may continue with Warring as Punjab party chief

author: TNN
description: Organized cleanliness drives now precede Prime Minister Modi's state visits across India. These initiatives transform pre-VVIP spruce-ups into public campaigns involving citizens and officials. Haryana launched a statewide drive ahead of Prime Minister Modi's upcoming visit to Jind. Similar campaigns were observed in Odisha and West Bengal during recent visits. The true success of these drives will be measured by sustained cleanliness after the visits conclude.
title: BJP turns PM Modi visits to states into 'swachh' drives

author: TOI TRENDING DESK
description: In a stunning display of generosity, Leonardo DiCaprio left a remarkable €50,000 tip for a waiter while enjoying the glitz of Saint-Tropez. This act underscores not only his substantial wealth but also his dedication to philanthropy. Over the years, the actor has curated an impressive portfolio of real estate that includes exquisite properties stretching from the Hollywood Hills to beautiful Malibu coastlines, showcasing his astute investment acumen.
title: DiCaprio once tipped a waiter in France with a €50k tip, leaving the server in tears

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Tyler Herro is saying goodbye to more than just the Miami Heat. After being traded to the Milwaukee Bucks in a blockbuster deal involving Giannis Antetokounmpo, the NBA star has also put his luxurious South Florida mansion on the market. Herro has listed his Pinecrest, Florida home for just under $12 million, nearly three years after purchasing the property for $10.5 million in 2022.
title: Tyler Herro lists $12m Florida mansion after blockbuster trade to Milwaukee Bucks

author: PRASHANT RUPERA AND TUSHAR PRABHUNE
description: Barnacles on Gujarat's coast show high microplastic contamination levels. Shivrajpur beach, a Blue Flag site, recorded the highest concentration of these particles. Researchers found microplastics in barnacles, seawater, and coastal sediments across thirteen locations. Plastic waste entering rivers and industrial effluents contribute significantly to this marine pollution. These findings highlight the widespread presence of plastic pollution in the marine ecosystem.
title: Tiny creatures of sea expose big story of Gujarat’s plastic waste

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Innovative Microsoft engineer Charles Simonyi cleverly leveraged a bespoke superyacht to sidestep local taxation and stringent construction regulations. This mobile abode enabled him to traverse the globe while circumventing substantial property tax liabilities. His forward-thinking strategy predates ongoing discussions surrounding wealth taxation in high-levy regions. A trailblazer in digital technology and space tourism, he eventually acquired an even grander superyacht to enhance his aquatic adventures.
title: Billionaire spent half the year on superyacht to avoid property taxes
